quote: You carry shadows you refuse to name. You hide the pain beneath quiet smiles. Every night you replay the old losses. The empty rooms echo with your silence. You wait for a peace that never arrives. Healing is not forgetting the heavy dark hours. It is learning to breathe inside the ruins.
